notes.title: Welcome to the (S)Unshine Arcade!
notes.content:
Woah, first Steam announcement! 
Though the steam page has been silently up for several months already, A bigger, more proper announcement is in the works. Expect that in the coming weeks. Stay tuned!

I've been actively working on the demo, and thanks to the help of various playtesters in the Unshine Arcade discord the first version has been shaping up nicely. (Still looking for more playtesters, so feel free to hop in if you’d like to help out!)

Once the alpha version of the demo is ready, it’ll be available through Steam Playtest. This will help me prepare for the full proper demo release later this year, but more on that later. 



Oh, and one more thing: this week Unshine Arcade is part of No Time To Loot! Alongside an amazing list of games all about celebrating gacha balls, I mean- loot. You can find the festival page linked right at the top of the Unshine Arcade Steam page.
